Use the saved draft for each formal browser work. Complete the remaining real account/time/duplicate checks and submit once through the platform UI. Save the minimal submission status. Native success uses observe_native_engagement then the same engagement actions for recommendation/comment. These actions are authorized for the same work; no new approval. Already done is not repeated. A genuinely missing platform control is not_present; a failed selector is not proof of absence. Login or identity verification goes to the owner. An unknown comment/like result is read back before any retry.

Use reconcile_publications for durable real post receipts at any time; it does not create a new upload. Background website registration keeps honest native/browser source and time precision. Exact platform ID/time may remain unknown on native observations; never fabricate it. Queue/review/submitted remain separate from public.

Use run_collection_tick for background next-day/day-after work. Observe the correct work current data view once, save actual visible cumulative metrics and actual/approximate observation time, leave unseen metrics null. Normal delay is allowed; do not turn late current data into a historical exact T24/T48 sample. Collection does not block publishing or engagement.

Keep credentials and claim tokens in memory/hidden stdin only. Keep minimal durable package/draft/submission/comment/like states to resume without repeats. No new paid media, production automation or duplicate scheduled automation. Notify only for actual human action, failure/unknown outcome or meaningful results.
completion_limit: Implementation/deployment and saved drafts are reported separately from actual on-time publication and engagement. Only real UI results verify a platform action; tests, queued tasks and instructions are not proof that it ran.
